sourceAuthority.rule: Provider output is challenger evidence only until normalized, technically validated, rights/provenance verified, literally reviewed, promoted, runtime-bound, live-read back, and receipted.

executionBoundary.nextAction: Authenticated provider/API inspection and zero/minimal-cost readiness call; generation only after auth state and expected cost are known.

defaults.style: photoreal physically plausible ordinary real-world environment; no sci-fi; no fantasy glow; no AI-mush; human-scale architecture
